operations.name: list
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of all domains for the authenticated reseller.

operations.name: catchIndex
operations.description: Get a list of all domain catch requests for the reseller.

operations.name: catchStore
operations.description: Create a new domain catch request to monitor and automatically register an expiring/deleted domain. A catch fee of 5 EUR will be charged immediately.

data.message: Catch request created. Domain will be monitored for availability.

operations.name: catchShow
operations.description: Get detailed information about a specific domain catch request.

operations.name: catchCancel
operations.description: Cancel an active domain catch request. Note: The catch fee is non-refundable.

operations.name: check
operations.description: Check if a single domain is available for registration.

operations.name: checkBulk
operations.description: Check availability of multiple domains at once (max 50).

operations.name: register
operations.description: Register a new domain with the specified handle and nameservers.

operations.name: dnsRecordTypes
operations.description: Returns all DNS record types supported by the DNS provider (ClouDNS), each with a description. NS and SOA are excluded since they are managed automatically.

record_types.description: Maps a hostname to an IPv4 address.
record_types.germanDescription: Verknuepft einen Hostnamen mit einer IPv4-Adresse.

record_types.description: Maps a hostname to an IPv6 address.
record_types.germanDescription: Verknuepft einen Hostnamen mit einer IPv6-Adresse.

operations.name: handlesIndex
operations.description: Get a list of all domain handles (contacts) for the reseller.

operations.name: handlesStore
operations.description: Create a new domain handle (contact) for domain registration. The `type` field controls whether this is a personal (`individual`) or company (`organization`) contact. When `type` is `organization`, the `organization` field is required. The `house_number`, `fax`, `state`, and `is_default` fields are optional for both types.

type.description: Contact type: individual (private person) or organization (company)

first_name.description: First name of the contact person

last_name.description: Last name of the contact person

organization.description: Company name — required when type is organization, optional for individuals

phone.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. +491234567890

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, US, GB

is_default.description: Set as default handle for new domain registrations (optional)

operations.name: handlesShow
operations.description: Get detailed information about a specific domain handle.

operations.name: handlesDestroy
operations.description: Delete a domain handle. Cannot delete if handle is in use by domains.

operations.name: handlesDomains
operations.description: Get a list of all domains that use this handle as registrant.

operations.name: handlesUpdate
operations.description: Update an existing domain handle. Changes are synced to all providers.

operations.name: pricing
operations.description: Get pricing for all available TLDs. If reseller has custom pricing, those prices are returned.

tld.description: Filter by specific TLD (e.g., de, com)

operations.name: pricingPromos
operations.description: Get only TLDs that currently have an active promo/action price for create, renew and/or transfer. If reseller has custom pricing, those prices are used to resolve the regular price.

tld.description: Filter by specific TLD (e.g., de, com)

responses.description: Active promo prices, one entry per TLD and action
responses.germanDescription: Aktive Aktionspreise, ein Eintrag pro TLD und Aktion

operations.name: statistics
operations.description: Get domain statistics including count by TLD, status, and expiration info.

operations.name: suggestions
operations.description: Get alternative domain suggestions for a given name across popular TLDs.

name.description: The domain name (without TLD) to get suggestions for

operations.name: transfer
operations.description: Initiate a domain transfer from another registrar. "nameserver_mode" chooses what happens with the nameservers: "platform" (default) points the domain at our nameservers once the transfer completes, "external" keeps the nameservers of the previous provider (no zone is created here; switch later with POST {domain}/nameservers/platform). "dns_import" (only with "platform") takes the current DNS records of the old provider along: "scan" scans them for review, "apply" scans and writes them into our zone automatically. Default is "none".

operations.name: get
operations.description: Returns detailed information about a specific domain.

operations.name: authCode
operations.description: Generate or retrieve the auth code for outbound domain transfer.

operations.name: disableAutoRenew
operations.description: Disable automatic renewal for the domain. Domain will be deleted at end of registration period.

operations.name: dnsIndex
operations.description: Returns all DNS records for the domain.

operations.name: dnsImportDestroy
operations.description: Discards the current scan result without changing the DNS zone, e.g. to start a fresh scan.

operations.name: dnsImportShow
operations.description: Returns the state of the DNS import (scan of the previous provider's zone) and, once the scan is completed, the found records.

responses.description: DNS import state. "status" is null (no import), pending, scanning, completed, failed or applied.
responses.germanDescription: DNS-Import-Status. "status" ist null (kein Import), pending, scanning, completed, failed oder applied.

operations.name: dnsImportStore
operations.description: Scans the zone currently served by the previous provider (best effort, e.g. via AXFR or enumeration of common names). Only possible while the domain uses our nameservers (nameserver_mode "platform") and ideally before the transfer completes. With "auto_apply" the found records are written into our zone as soon as the scan is done; otherwise fetch them with GET and apply them with POST dns-import/apply.

operations.name: dnsImportApply
operations.description: Writes records of a completed scan into our DNS zone. Send "records" to apply an edited selection; without it all importable records of the scan are applied.

operations.name: dnsUpdate
operations.description: Create, update, or delete DNS records. Send the complete list of desired records.

operations.name: dnssecIndex
operations.description: Returns the DNSSEC status and records for the domain.

operations.name: dnssecUpdate
operations.description: Enable or disable DNSSEC for the domain. When enabling, provide DS records.

operations.name: enableAutoRenew
operations.description: Enable automatic renewal for the domain.

operations.name: nameserversIndex
operations.description: Returns the nameservers configured for the domain.

operations.name: nameserversPlatform
operations.description: Points an active domain at our nameservers (or the reseller's whitelabel nameservers), e.g. after an incoming transfer with nameserver_mode "external". The zone is created first. With "dns_import" the records currently served by the old nameservers are taken along: "scan" for review, "apply" to write them into the zone automatically.

data.message: Nameserver switch to platform nameservers started

operations.name: nameserversUpdate
operations.description: Update the nameservers for the domain. Minimum 2, maximum 6 nameservers required.
